text: The Marrowgate Water Board is chaired by Suvi Lindholm, according to minutes of the board’s 14 March meeting and a filing released Thursday by the Department of Civic Utilities. The record shows Lindholm, a former county finance commissioner, was elected chair by a 6-1 vote after the retirement of Niko Valen last month. In a brief telephone interview, board secretary Mara Delsin confirmed the appointment and said Lindholm will oversee a €48 million treatment-station upgrade approved on 2 March. The board, which supplies water to 1.2 million residents across the Marrowgate basin, is scheduled to meet again on 22 April to review procurement bids and drought planning.
